notes: Chunk 84: six pages, nine Common Crawl snapshots, all readable. University of Mannheim (CDSB Alumni, 2018 and 2020 captures): year headings are not explained on the page, so yearMeaning is 'unstated'; the position/destination shown is the affiliation displayed at capture time (an alumni directory, not a first-placement list) and it changes between the two captures for many people; 'position' and 'destination' were split at the first comma or ' at ' as written, company-only lines are destination only; program recorded as 'CDSB' (the page names it 'Business (CDSB)'); no degree is printed per person. University of Pittsburgh (PhD Student Job Placements, 2017 and 2018 captures): no years on the page, so listedYear is null with yearMeaning 'placement'; the page says it is 'some of our placements from each area'; 'now at'/'currently at' text is kept in note with the first-listed institution as destination; in both captures the 'Marketing' heading repeats the Information Systems list verbatim (recorded once, under Information Systems, with a note); in the 2017 capture the 'Finance' heading lists a group (Kovacheva, Yildirim, Dommer, Nenkov, ...) that the 2018 capture drops in favour of a different Finance list, so the 2017 heading may be a page error (recorded as written with a note); several 2018 Finance names carry a text-extraction space after the first letter (e.g. 'T omas Jandik'), recorded without the space and noted; the Business Analytics and Operations block has five names run together on one line, split by the extractor. University of Toledo (Digital Commons 'Theses and Dissertations in Business Administration'): the year is the repository's thesis year ('Theses/Dissertations from YYYY'), recorded as 'unstated'; the collection does not separate master's theses from doctoral dissertations, so degree is null; dissertation titles are in note. University of Warwick WRAP (two department browse pages): every entry is labelled 'PhD thesis, University of Warwick'; the year in parentheses is the thesis year (recorded 'unstated'); names are in 'Surname, Given' order as written; the department comes from the page address (the second one truncated to 'Warwick_Business_Schoo'); theses date 1978-1992. University of Washington Foster (Students on the Job Market, captured 2019-10-18): candidates are labelled 'PhC'; the page states no year, so listedYear is null with yearMeaning 'job-market'; the integrator may read the capture date as the 2019-20 season.
